cases.title: Send is blocked until the setup is complete
preconditions: Signer names and emails NOT yet entered
steps: Check the button at the top right next to "Send"
Click it to open the checklist
expected: It says "N to fix before sending" in red
The checklist lists what is missing (names/emails, fields with no owner)

cases.title: Send anyway with fields still in Needs review
preconditions: At least one card still in Needs review (low confidence)
expected: The checklist button says "N to review" in amber
The dialog says how many fields the AI wasn't sure about

cases.title: Send to others only
preconditions: No signer has "This is me" ticked
expected: The Status page opens: both signers show "Waiting for signature (link sent)"
Notifications list "sent" to the sender and "your turn" to each signer

cases.title: Send with yourself as a signer
preconditions: A fresh upload in Review with signer details entered
Tick "This is me" on one signer
expected: Your own signing page opens straight away, with only your fields active
The other signer already has a "your turn" entry in the Outbox

cases.title: Self only
steps: Remove every signer except one ("Remove signer")
Move every field to the remaining signer
Type your own name and the sender's email, tick "This is me"
expected: After you finish, the document is completed and "Download signed PDF" is available

cases.title: A sent document can't be edited
expected: The Status page opens, not Review
